text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Now then... allow me to introduce myself once again.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I'm Aston Machan.
...Pleased to meet you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With that, she gave a shy, bashful smile.
My reflection was caught in her round, gently twinkling eyes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The story goes back a few days prior—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, I came with a colleague to watch mock races in search of
a horsegirl to train. The stands were unusually restless. And that's because—

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
It's the Rookie Horsegirl Scouting Special, 'New Paka'! Today, live from Tracen
Academy, we'll be introducing wonderful new rookies to viewers across the nation!

text_block_list.name: Colleague Trainer
text_block_list.text:
A TV crew really came out! The racers must be super pumped
...Wait, no, they actually look pretty nervous.

text_block_list.name: Colleague Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Looks like Aston Machan is the only calm one out there?
Man, she's got some real guts.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking where my colleague pointed, amidst the tense atmosphere,
there stood a horsegirl entering the gate with a serene, gentle smile.

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
—Here we are in the closing stage, heading into the final stretch!
Who will make the first move?!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Hup!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
It's Aston Machan! Catching the lead with her unique pitch running style,
Aston Machan pulls ahead by half a length—and crosses the line!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WAAAHHHHH...!)

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *pant*... Whew.
Ehehe, peace.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's catch them as they come off the track!
First up, our first-place finisher, Aston Machan—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: I'm Aston Machan. Pleased to meet you.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
A-Aston Machan?! ...Er, Miss Machan!
We're from 'New Paka'! That was a magnificent race!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Did you see it? I was actually trying a little bit hard.
...Oh, and this is the Machan doll. 'Hello~'

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
...U-Um, what an adorable doll! By the way,
have you already decided on a trainer to work with?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: That happens to be a grave issue. One has yet to appear.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
Oh, is that so?!
Well, I'm sure you'll get tons of scout offers after that race!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As if summoned by those very words,
a crowd of trainers quickly surrounded Aston Machan.

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan! Please let me train you!
I'll design training menus tailored specifically around your stride!

text_block_list.name: Colleague Trainer
text_block_list.text:
P-Please consider me too!
I promise not to let your natural talent go to waste—I'll bring out your best!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
I knew it! Alright, make sure you get good shots of this.
We might capture the moment a contract is signed...!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
Now then, what answer will our promising rookie Aston Machan
give to all these hopeful trainers?!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...What are your dreams, everyone?

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer
text_block_list.text:
............Huh?
Oh, well naturally, it's to win a GⅠ race alongside you!

text_block_list.name: Colleague Trainer
text_block_list.text:
I want to aim for Horsegirl of the Year together!
I'll make you the strongest racer of our generation!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Hmm-hmm, hmm-hmm-hmm... Mhm.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
............
...Understood. See you around~!

text_block_list.name: Mid-Career Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Wait, hold on! Of course I want to connect
with you too! Please, tell me your dream!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Machan's dream is to become a mascot.

text_block_list.name: Trainers
text_block_list.text: ...A-A mascot?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Not just any ordinary mascot, though.
A globe-trotting super mascot.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Appearing in every corner of the world, held in everyone's hands...
That kind of super—no, ultra-super mascot is what I want to be!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Yes, so that's how it is.
And so, see you around~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan left after saying that, leaving behind
nothing but a group of utterly flabbergasted adults.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While her distinct stride style in the race showed undeniable talent,
her mysterious aura left an even deeper impression.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: On the way home from that mock race—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me.
Could you hold the camera for me~?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I'd like you to film me singing in the central plaza.
I went and clean forgot my tripod, you see.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Whoa whoa, hold on, I never said I was on board!
Singing "Umapyoi Densetsu" in a place like this makes no sense at all!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: The more videos we have, the better.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
You've got way too many already!
Besides, why do you gotta film yourself singing out of nowhere anyway?!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Because I realized I hadn't filmed that yet.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Ugh, give me a break. She's not listening to a word right now.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
She gets so stubborn once she's like this...
Oh well. Let's just film it quick and go home.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for springing this on you, but would you mind?
This girl, she really... well, she just loves doing this sort of thing.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Yay.
Here, please use this smartphone.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Um, all right then.
I'd like you to frame it from about here toward over there, kind of like this.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mysterious, fond of being recorded, and an extraordinary runner.
That was my first impression of Aston Machan.
